{{Quote|However, while the ''Nemesis'' is an extremely effective weapons-platform, perfectly suited to the roles of close-air support and civilian pacification, it may simply be too exotic for widespread service.|[[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]]-[[General/Legends|General]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rebu]]|<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Nemesis''-class gunship''' was an experimental [[Gunship/Legends|military vessel]] that was produced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the early phase of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The gunship boasted an array of heavy weapons, including missile launchers and a heavy repeating cannon. But due to the complexities and firepower incorporated in its design, the gunship came with a very heavy price tag, thus making it affordable only to wealthiest [[Moff/Legends|regional governors]] of the Empire.

Barely a [[1 BBY/Legends|year]] after the onset of the Galactic Civil War, a [[Subject 1138|renegade clone]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death/Legends|late]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]], [[Galen Marek]], traveled to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] to [[Rescue of Rahm Kota|rescue]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. As the rogue [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] unleashed a relentless rampage of devastation on [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]] and its [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial garrison]], he soon discovered that two ''Nemesis''-class gunships were included in the city's defense by the planetary administrator, [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]]. Yet despite their considerable and deadly arsenal, both gunships proved to be no match against the clone's [[Force power/Legends|extremely powerful]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|command]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Shortly after destroying the gunships, the clone successfully rescued Kota from captivity, resulting in Tarko's death and the complete destruction of his city.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|During certain maneuvers, the jets produce a turbulent backwash of superheated air which creates an immensely loud, high-pitched shrieking sound.|Inspector-General Moff Rebu|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
[[File:NemesisGunship2.png|thumb|200px]]
The ''Nemesis''-class gunship was designed to provide close-air support for [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] and to pacify rebellious citizens. Consequently, the gunships of the ''Nemesis'' design were built as heavy-weapons platforms. Their arsenal incorporated an array of highly advanced weapons, as well as better quality in firepower and greater quantity in ammunition than previous gunships. The ''Nemesis''{{'}} primary weapons were the anti-personnel [[Hellcaster cannon]] and the anti-armor [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launchers.<ref name="Databank" />

Another unique feature in the design of the ''Nemesis''-class was its engine system. Unlike previous gunships that utilized the usual [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines, the ''Nemesis'' was equipped with a jet-drive system, which produced a turbulent backwash of superheated air that created an extremely high-pitched sound. Due to the vessel's angled jet-drives, only specially trained [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were capable of controlling the ''Nemesis''-class gunships.<ref name="Databank" />

==Role==
{{Quote|Both the Hellcaster cannon and concussion missiles were highly effective in, respectively, an anti-personnel and anti-armor capacity, and the gunship returned to base with only minimal damage.|Inspector-General Moff Rebu|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
The Galactic Empire ruled through the fear of its citizens, particularly their fear of the relentless Imperial war machine and its unrivaled technology. Therefore, Imperial starships and vehicles were designed to strike terror deep into the Empire's enemies, both in appearance and firepower. The ''Nemesis''-class gunship was a direct result of the Imperial hardline stance on galactic domination and total war. Like many other vessels in the Empire's seemingly unlimited arsenal, the ''Nemesis'' was built for the purpose of breaking the resolve of enemy units, either through fear of the threat of force, or though the exercising of said force.<ref name="Databank" />

The ''Nemesis''-class gunship was suitable for both military operations against insurgent elements and planetary occupation to suppress discontent civilians. In either capacity, the ''Nemesis'' was meant to project the might of Imperial power and the futility of rebellion. The ''Nemesis''{{'}} performance on [[Polomie]] and its role on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] are testaments to its primary function as a symbol of terror, as well as its effectiveness against enemy units and vehicles.<ref name="Databank" />

By and large, the ''Nemesis''{{'}} greatest strengths were its highly destructive&mdash;and incredibly expensive&mdash;arsenal and firepower. With its Hellcaster cannon and concussion missile launchers, combined with a large quantity of ammunition, the gunship was one of the most lethal vessels in the Imperial Navy by the year 1 BBY. Although the metal that composed its hull offered strong protection against conventional weapons and attacks,<ref name="Databank" /> the gunship was extremely vulnerable to its own weapons. During the [[Rescue of Rahm Kota|destruction of Tarko-se]] on Cato Neimoidia, a [[Subject 1138|wayward clone of]] [[Galen Marek]] destroyed two ''Nemesis''-class gunships by [[Telekinesis/Legends|redirecting]] concussion missiles back to their original source.<ref name="TFUII" />

==History==
===Development and testing===
{{Quote|I am pleased to report that the Cygnus Spaceworks Nemesis-class gunship exceeded all expectations during its first field test against the Rebel stronghold on Polomie.|Inspector-General Moff Rebu|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
[[File:Merillion_Tarko.png|thumb|left|150px|Baron Merillion Tarko possessed two ''Nemesis''-class gunships in his private army.]]
Around the time when the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] broke out between the dominant [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] had just completed a new [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The ''Nemesis''-class gunship was regarded as the most exotically designed military vessel of its time. The ''Nemesis'' was given its first field test on [[Polomie]] where [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial armed forces]] were dispatched to destroy a Rebel stronghold. The ''Nemesis''{{'}} performance was virtually nothing less than perfection. Aside from exceeding all expectations of its hopeful designers and employers, the ''Nemesis'' barely retained minimal damage from its first engagement.<ref name="Databank" />

An unexpected, yet welcomed side-effect of the ''Nemesis''{{'}} jet-drive system was discovered during the fighting as well. The gunship's jets produced an extremely loud shrieking noise that caused Rebel morale to decrease significantly, to the point where many [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troops]] dropped their weapons and fled in utter terror. [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]]-[[General/Legends|General]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rebu]] praised the ''Nemesis'', especially the characteristics and effects of its exceptionally well-designed weapons system, in his report to the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]].<ref name="Databank" />

However, despite Moff Rebu's full recommendation of the ''Nemesis''-class gunship, he was displeased to realize that the unique vessel would never likely see mass production precisely because of its "one of a kind" status. Ironically, the ''Nemesis'' was far too complicated by its own design. Its use of angled jet drives, rather than [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]], required specially trained pilots, thus putting too high a demand on manpower. The vessel's weaponry were also an issue; the Hellcaster cannon required heavy elements that made ammunition too expensive and difficult to produce. As a result, only the Empire's wealthiest Moffs and [[Governor/Legends|governors]] were able to afford to pay for the ''Nemesis''{{'}} extremely high price.<ref name="Databank" />

===Catastrophe on Cato Neimoidia===
{{Quote|Consequently, the ''Nemesis'' is likely to be seen only within the private forces of particularly wealthy Moffs and governors.|Inspector-General Moff Rebu|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
[[File:Starkiller_Cato_Neimoidia.png|thumb|right|250px|A renegade clone of the original Starkiller destroyed Baron Tarko's ''Nemesis''-class gunships on Cato Neimoidia.]]
Moff Rebu's prediction of the limited use of ''Nemesis''-class gunships were proven to be accurate. Due to their limited numbers, the highly experimental gunships were regulated to Imperial-occupied worlds where the native populations had to be occasionally pacified&mdash;a suitable role for the ''Nemesis''. One of the Moffs who was able to afford the costs of the gunship was [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]], the Imperial governor of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. As a former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] world that betrayed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Empire naturally attached a large military garrison to occupy the planet and ensure its loyalty to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Although the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] were cowards by instinct without the protection of their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Techno Union Droid Army/Legends|army]], Tarko nonetheless added two ''Nemesis''-class gunships to his private force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], [[Jumptrooper/Legends|jumptroopers]], [[carbonite war droid]]s and [[Imperial Sith Acolyte]]s.<ref name="Databank" />

By [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a [[Subject 1138|rogue clone]] of the [[Death/Legends|late]] [[Galen Marek]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|former apprentice]] to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], escaped from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Created amongst a series of [[Aberrant clone|genetically-imperfect duplicates]] secretly commissioned by Vader, the renegade [[Cloning/Legends|clone's]] [[Memory flash|imprinted memories]] caused him to share some of the same characteristics as his [[Clone template/Legends|genetic donor]], particularly Marek's feelings for Imperial-turned-Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]. As a result of his imperfections, the clone deserted his creator and commandeered an [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|advanced TIE fighter]] to escape into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TFUII" />

In his search for Captain Eclipse, the clone decided to travel to Cato Neimoidia and [[Rescue of Rahm Kota|rescue]] his progenitor's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|mentor]], [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], who had been captured and forced to fight in the [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]] [[Tarko-se Arena|arena]] after failing to [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|assassinate]] Baron Tarko. As soon as the clone arrived in Tarko's city, Imperial troops attempted to kill him when they realized that he was an intruder. The clone proceeded to destroy much of the Imperial garrison, easily overpowering waves of stormtroopers and auxiliary units throughout Tarko-se. In desperation, Tarko unleashed his personal ''Nemesis''-class gunship against the clone. The vessel's Hellcaster cannon caused the clone to go into a [[Force speed/Legends|Force-enhanced]] sprint across a bridge until he escaped into the city's [[Infinite Nebstar Casino|casino complex]].<ref name="TFUII" />

When the clone utilized a [[Train/Legends|hover train]] to travel over to the city's western arch, the gunship resumed its attack on the clone, firing repeated shots and concussion missiles at the clone and the train. Despite the ''Nemesis''{{'}} exceptional armaments, its weapons were utterly useless against the [[Force power/Legends|sheer power]] of the clone and his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|incredible connection]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The clone was able to use the gunship's own weapons against it by repelling its missiles with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] abilities. The gunship sustained incredible amounts of damage from its own missiles, causing it to explode as the clone reached his destination, however the hover train he was standing on was also too badly damaged and began to fall from the sky just as he reached the end.<ref name="TFUII" />

As the clone battled his way to the arena's entrance, the second ''Nemesis''-class gunship was dispatched in a last ditch attempt to stop his progress. After slaughtering the last of the Imperials that stood in his way, the gunship tried to suppress the clone with its missiles and Hellcaster cannon. The clone used the missiles to destroy the cannon and inflict severe damage to the gunship. Through the Force, he seized the ''Nemesis'' and caused it to crash against the arena bridge's support infrastructure until finally destroying the gunship completely. Shortly afterward, the clone succeeded in his objective to rescue General Kota, though his efforts also resulted in the complete destruction of the arena and the death of Baron Tarko.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:NemesisXsection.jpg|200px|right]]
The design of the ''Nemesis''-class Gunship was developed because the ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''{{'s}} design staff, "needed a bigger, more powerful version of the Imperial troop transport—one with a lot more guns, missiles, and engines." Concept artist [[Chun Gee]] did the final render and design, as well a cross-section of the craft. The design team considered the additional detail from the cross-section an, "invaluable piece of reference for artists who were implementing damage effects because Starkiller absolutely punishes the gunship during gameplay."<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">The Digital Art Book included in the ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' Collector's Edition Starkiller Mimobot</ref>
